## We’re serious about facts.
## Ask away.

### How do I get started?

You're unique, and your hair growth plan should be too. That's why we created our [Hair Wellness
Quiz][41]—a quick 3-minute assessment that allows us to better understand your specific root causes
of hair thinning and recommend a personalized product regimen that will give you results.

### How do I qualify for the Real Growth Guarantee^{∞}?

It's easy! Purchase 6 bottles of any Nutraceutical through a subscription within 180 days, take 4
capsules each day, and download the myNutrafol app within 30 days of placing your first order. Make
sure to check in regularly and submit monthly progress photos in the app.

[View all FAQs][42]

### Is Nutrafol suitable for everyone?

Not only is Nutrafol suitable for most people, but our hair growth supplements are specifically
formulated to meet you where you are in life. We have 5 Nutraceutical formulas that are tailored to
the bio-specific needs of men and women throughout all life stages: Women's, Women’s Vegan,
Postpartum for the first year after childbirth or while breastfeeding, Women's Balance for peri- and
postmenopause, and Men's.

Please note: We do not recommend Nutrafol to anyone under the age of 18. Also, while we have no
reason to believe it's harmful, there have not been enough studies for us to say Nutrafol is
suitable during pregnancy—so we recommend skipping it while pregnant or trying to conceive and
sticking with Nutrafol Postpartum while breastfeeding. If you have a medical condition, or are
taking medications (especially anticoagulant and blood-thinning drugs), please consult with your
physician before taking Nutrafol.

### What is the difference between Nutrafol's Hair Growth Nutraceuticals?

Our Hair Growth Nutraceuticals are clinically effective and physician-formulated to the bio-specific
needs of men and women through all life stages and lifestyles.^{*} The key root causes of thinning
hair affect men and women differently and can change over time—so we created multiple formulas to
give your hair exactly what it needs, when it needs it most.

Women’s formula focuses on addressing the key root causes of hair thinning for women 18-44 years old
when stress, lifestyle habits, and nutrition play a heightened role in hair health.

Women’s Vegan is formulated for women 18-44 with the key root causes of thinning focusing on stress
and lifestyle habits, plus it is optimized to support plant-based diet’s nutrition and absorption of
nutrients in the body that affect hair health.

Women’s Balance is formulated for women 45+ to support the key root causes of hair thinning for
women, such as stress, with optimized support for hormonal changes, such as menopause, that affect
hair health.

Postpartum is OBGYN-formulated to address the key root causes of hair thinning and shedding for
women within the first year of giving birth and through the time they are breastfeeding, such as the
physical and emotional stress, hormonal changes, and nutritional support.

Men’s formula multi-targets the key root causes of thinning for men 18+, such as stress and poor
nutrition, with optimized support of hair growth-inhibiting DHT hormone, without compromising sexual
performance.

### Will Nutrafol work for my hair type?

Nutrafol was formulated to promote hair growth for all types of hair. While the characteristics of
hair strands may vary by ethnicity, the underlying root causes that affect hair follicles can affect
all people equally.

In a recent clinical study, we examined the effectiveness of Nutrafol in African American, Asian,
Hispanic, and Non Hispanic men and women. All ethnicities saw less shedding after two months and
improved thickness, growth rate, scalp coverage, and shine after six months.

### When can I expect to see results?

Everyone's experience is different, but in our clinical studies, women showed results in 3-6 months.
It's important to remember that healthy hair growth takes time—and of course, consistency is key. If
you take Nutrafol daily, here's a snapshot of what you're likely to experience:

1-3 months: Strengthen hair from within. Look for shinier hair with less shedding and breakage.

3-6 months: You may notice improvement in fullness and volume.

6+ months: Experience visible changes like faster-growing hair that’s thicker and stronger with more
scalp coverage.

Commitment to Nutrafol has whole-body rewards, too. Our ingredients are shown to promote more
restful sleep, less stress, better mood, and clearer skin. A little something we call side benefits.

## We’re serious about facts.
## Ask away.

### How do I get started?

You're unique, and your hair growth plan should be too. That's why we created our [Hair Wellness
Quiz][41]—a quick 3-minute assessment that allows us to better understand your specific root causes
of hair thinning and recommend a personalized product regimen that will give you results.

### How do I qualify for the Real Growth Guarantee^{∞}?

It's easy! Purchase 6 bottles of any Nutraceutical through a subscription within 180 days, take 4
capsules each day, and download the myNutrafol app within 30 days of placing your first order. Make
sure to check in regularly and submit monthly progress photos in the app.

[View all FAQs][42]

### Is Nutrafol suitable for everyone?

Not only is Nutrafol suitable for most people, but our hair growth supplements are specifically
formulated to meet you where you are in life. We have 5 Nutraceutical formulas that are tailored to
the bio-specific needs of men and women throughout all life stages: Women's, Women’s Vegan,
Postpartum for the first year after childbirth or while breastfeeding, Women's Balance for peri- and
postmenopause, and Men's.

Please note: We do not recommend Nutrafol to anyone under the age of 18. Also, while we have no
reason to believe it's harmful, there have not been enough studies for us to say Nutrafol is
suitable during pregnancy—so we recommend skipping it while pregnant or trying to conceive and
sticking with Nutrafol Postpartum while breastfeeding. If you have a medical condition, or are
taking medications (especially anticoagulant and blood-thinning drugs), please consult with your
physician before taking Nutrafol.

### What is the difference between Nutrafol's Hair Growth Nutraceuticals?

Our Hair Growth Nutraceuticals are clinically effective and physician-formulated to the bio-specific
needs of men and women through all life stages and lifestyles.^{*} The key root causes of thinning
hair affect men and women differently and can change over time—so we created multiple formulas to
give your hair exactly what it needs, when it needs it most.

Women’s formula focuses on addressing the key root causes of hair thinning for women 18-44 years old
when stress, lifestyle habits, and nutrition play a heightened role in hair health.

Women’s Vegan is formulated for women 18-44 with the key root causes of thinning focusing on stress
and lifestyle habits, plus it is optimized to support plant-based diet’s nutrition and absorption of
nutrients in the body that affect hair health.

Women’s Balance is formulated for women 45+ to support the key root causes of hair thinning for
women, such as stress, with optimized support for hormonal changes, such as menopause, that affect
hair health.

Postpartum is OBGYN-formulated to address the key root causes of hair thinning and shedding for
women within the first year of giving birth and through the time they are breastfeeding, such as the
physical and emotional stress, hormonal changes, and nutritional support.

Men’s formula multi-targets the key root causes of thinning for men 18+, such as stress and poor
nutrition, with optimized support of hair growth-inhibiting DHT hormone, without compromising sexual
performance.

### Will Nutrafol work for my hair type?

Nutrafol was formulated to promote hair growth for all types of hair. While the characteristics of
hair strands may vary by ethnicity, the underlying root causes that affect hair follicles can affect
all people equally.

In a recent clinical study, we examined the effectiveness of Nutrafol in African American, Asian,
Hispanic, and Non Hispanic men and women. All ethnicities saw less shedding after two months and
improved thickness, growth rate, scalp coverage, and shine after six months.

### When can I expect to see results?

Everyone's experience is different, but in our clinical studies, women showed results in 3-6 months.
It's important to remember that healthy hair growth takes time—and of course, consistency is key. If
you take Nutrafol daily, here's a snapshot of what you're likely to experience:

1-3 months: Strengthen hair from within. Look for shinier hair with less shedding and breakage.

3-6 months: You may notice improvement in fullness and volume.

6+ months: Experience visible changes like faster-growing hair that’s thicker and stronger with more
scalp coverage.

Commitment to Nutrafol has whole-body rewards, too. Our ingredients are shown to promote more
restful sleep, less stress, better mood, and clearer skin. A little something we call side benefits.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What are ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products?

ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products are the first FDA-approved topical treatment that is clinically
proven to help regrow hair. [ROGAINE^{®}][39] minoxidil products also help to reverse the
progression of hereditary hair loss.

### How do ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products work?

The exact mechanism for [ROGAINE^{®}][40] minoxidil products is uncertain, however researchers
believe that ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products work in part by enlarging the hair follicles and
reversing the "miniaturization" process. This miniaturization of the hair follicles is a
characteristic of hereditary hair loss and can be impacted by hereditary, hormonal and age factors.

By enlarging the miniaturized follicles, the growth phase of the hair cycle is prolonged, allowing
the hair to become longer and thicker looking. And with more follicles in the growth phase at the
same time, your hair coverage will start to look thicker, too.

### Where can I use ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products?
* **Does ROGAINE**^{**®**}** minoxidil products work for receding hairline**
  ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products are approved for men experiencing gradual thinning or gradual hair
  loss on the top of the scalp. It is not intended for frontal baldness or receding hairline.
* **Does ROGAINE**^{**®**}** minoxidil products work for beards?**
  ROGAINE^{®} for beards has not been tested in clinical trials.
* **Does ROGAINE**^{**®**}** minoxidil products work on eyebrows?**
  ROGAINE^{®} for eyebrows has not been tested in clinical trials. Directions specifically state to
  avoid contact with eyes.

### How soon can I expect results?

It may take at least 4 months for results to be seen, and your results and success may depend on the
proper application and dosage.

There are a few signs to look for that let you know ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products are working.
During the first few weeks of use you may see a temporary increase in hair shedding. This is a good
sign and means that the new growth cycle is beginning, and the lost hairs are making way for the
new, healthy ones.

Eventually, new growth will appear. The earliest hair growth you see may be soft and downy, but
continued treatment will produce new hair with the same consistency as the other hair on your scalp.

Remember, not everyone responds to ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products and individual results will vary.
If hair loss continues after 2 weeks or if you do not see any results after 4 months, speak with
your doctor.

### How long should I continue to use ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products?

Hereditary hair loss is a lifelong condition requiring continuous use of ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil
products. Make it a part of your daily routine - just like brushing your teeth. Apply directly to
your scalp - everyday as directed.

### What happens if I stop using ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products?

Continued use of ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products is needed to maintain hair regrowth. While our
clinical studies did not go beyond 48 weeks, there is no limit on how long you may use ROGAINE^{®}
minoxidil products.

If you stop using it, the normal hair loss process will start again. You will probably lose your
newly regrown hair within 3 to 4 months and will look the way you looked before using ROGAINE^{®}
minoxidil products, so you'll want to make ROGAINE^{®} products part of your daily routine.

If you miss 1 or 2 doses of a ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil product, however, just continue with your next
regular dose. We do not recommend that you try to make up for missed doses, and 1 or 2 days of not
using a ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil product will not affect your long-term hair regrowth as long as you
resume regular use.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What are ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products?

ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products are the first FDA-approved topical treatment that is clinically
proven to help regrow hair. [ROGAINE^{®}][39] minoxidil products also help to reverse the
progression of hereditary hair loss.

### How do ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products work?

The exact mechanism for [ROGAINE^{®}][40] minoxidil products is uncertain, however researchers
believe that ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products work in part by enlarging the hair follicles and
reversing the "miniaturization" process. This miniaturization of the hair follicles is a
characteristic of hereditary hair loss and can be impacted by hereditary, hormonal and age factors.

By enlarging the miniaturized follicles, the growth phase of the hair cycle is prolonged, allowing
the hair to become longer and thicker looking. And with more follicles in the growth phase at the
same time, your hair coverage will start to look thicker, too.

### Where can I use ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products?
* **Does ROGAINE**^{**®**}** minoxidil products work for receding hairline**
  ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products are approved for men experiencing gradual thinning or gradual hair
  loss on the top of the scalp. It is not intended for frontal baldness or receding hairline.
* **Does ROGAINE**^{**®**}** minoxidil products work for beards?**
  ROGAINE^{®} for beards has not been tested in clinical trials.
* **Does ROGAINE**^{**®**}** minoxidil products work on eyebrows?**
  ROGAINE^{®} for eyebrows has not been tested in clinical trials. Directions specifically state to
  avoid contact with eyes.

### How soon can I expect results?

It may take at least 4 months for results to be seen, and your results and success may depend on the
proper application and dosage.

There are a few signs to look for that let you know ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products are working.
During the first few weeks of use you may see a temporary increase in hair shedding. This is a good
sign and means that the new growth cycle is beginning, and the lost hairs are making way for the
new, healthy ones.

Eventually, new growth will appear. The earliest hair growth you see may be soft and downy, but
continued treatment will produce new hair with the same consistency as the other hair on your scalp.

Remember, not everyone responds to ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products and individual results will vary.
If hair loss continues after 2 weeks or if you do not see any results after 4 months, speak with
your doctor.

### How long should I continue to use ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products?

Hereditary hair loss is a lifelong condition requiring continuous use of ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil
products. Make it a part of your daily routine - just like brushing your teeth. Apply directly to
your scalp - everyday as directed.

### What happens if I stop using ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products?

Continued use of ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products is needed to maintain hair regrowth. While our
clinical studies did not go beyond 48 weeks, there is no limit on how long you may use ROGAINE^{®}
minoxidil products.

If you stop using it, the normal hair loss process will start again. You will probably lose your
newly regrown hair within 3 to 4 months and will look the way you looked before using ROGAINE^{®}
minoxidil products, so you'll want to make ROGAINE^{®} products part of your daily routine.

If you miss 1 or 2 doses of a ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil product, however, just continue with your next
regular dose. We do not recommend that you try to make up for missed doses, and 1 or 2 days of not
using a ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil product will not affect your long-term hair regrowth as long as you
resume regular use.

4.      **ScalpMED® Feeds the Hair Follicles**

To understand how **ScalpMED®** stops hair loss and regrows lost hair, it’s important to know what
causes hair loss and thinning hair in the first place. In the simplest terms, a hormone called DHT
constricts blood vessels that supply vital oxygen and nutrients to hair follicles, until eventually,
the follicles can no longer grow hair.**ScalpMED®** keeps blood vessels in your scalp open. This
allows oxygen and nutrients to flow into hair follicles, helping to revive the dying follicles and
keep nutrients flowing, so that new healthy hair can grow.

## Dubai Hair Transplant

Dubai has gained a reputation, for its technology and top notch facilities, which also extend to the
field of hair transplants. At the Al Alborj hair transplant clinic in Dubai, knowledgeable and
skilled surgeons utilize the up, to date techniques and equipment to perform these procedures.

### What is hair Transplant Procedure?

# We are committed to **educating & improving** the lives of all those affected by hair loss.

[About Us][88]

### About Us

## The American Hair Loss Association

The American Hair Loss Association is the only national 501(c)(3), nonprofit, consumer organization
dedicated to educating the public, healthcare professionals, mainstream media and legislators about
the emotionally devastating disease of hair loss (alopecia).

Enhancing Medical Awareness
Exploring Genetic Understanding
Pioneering Research & Advocacy
[ Learn More ][89]

# In the Face of Hair Loss, We're All the Same

### Women’s Hair Loss

Mistakenly thought to be a strictly male disease, women actually make up forty percent of American
hair loss sufferers. Hair loss in women can be absolutely devastating for the sufferer's self image
and emotional well being.

[ Learn More ][90]

### Men’s Hair Loss

Androgenetic alopecia or common male pattern baldness (MPB) accounts for more than 95% of hair loss
in men. By the age of thirty-five two-thirds of American men will experience some degree of
appreciable hair loss.

[ Learn More ][91]

# We are committed to **educating & improving** the lives of all those affected by hair loss.

[About Us][88]

### About Us

## The American Hair Loss Association

The American Hair Loss Association is the only national 501(c)(3), nonprofit, consumer organization
dedicated to educating the public, healthcare professionals, mainstream media and legislators about
the emotionally devastating disease of hair loss (alopecia).

Enhancing Medical Awareness
Exploring Genetic Understanding
Pioneering Research & Advocacy
[ Learn More ][89]

# In the Face of Hair Loss, We're All the Same

### Women’s Hair Loss

Mistakenly thought to be a strictly male disease, women actually make up forty percent of American
hair loss sufferers. Hair loss in women can be absolutely devastating for the sufferer's self image
and emotional well being.

[ Learn More ][90]

### Men’s Hair Loss

Androgenetic alopecia or common male pattern baldness (MPB) accounts for more than 95% of hair loss
in men. By the age of thirty-five two-thirds of American men will experience some degree of
appreciable hair loss.

[ Learn More ][91]

suitable for you.

## Why Choose Our Clinic

At our clinic, we understand that healthy skin and confident hair play a vital role in your overall
well-being and self-confidence. That’s why we focus on providing **personalized, safe, and
result-oriented hair and skin treatments** using a perfect blend of medical expertise and modern
technology.

carefully assess each patient’s condition before recommending any treatment. We believe that no two
individuals are the same, so every treatment plan is customized according to your skin type, hair
condition, lifestyle, and medical history.

About Cosmetic Synergy

 

The name Cosmetic Synergy was chosen to represent collaboration and balance. Synergy reflects the
way different elements, professional knowledge, clinical experience, and patient preferences come
together to create an individualised and thoughtful approach to care.

 

The symbol of angel wings is woven into our practice identity as a personal reminder of the values
we uphold: protection, trust and care. These qualities guide every consultation and treatment,
ensuring patients feel supported in making informed decisions about their care.

## WELCOME TO COSMETIC SYNERGY

[Tara Hesp, registered nurse and founder of Cosmetic Synergy in Caringbah]

Meet Tara

Founder of Cosmetic Synergy

## MY APPROACH TO AGEING 

My approach is centred on listening, understanding, and working in partnership with patients. During
consultations, I take time to discuss goals, review options, and outline what may or may not be
suitable for each individual.

 

I believe treatments should support people in feeling comfortable and confident in their daily
lives. Safety and evidence-based practice guide every decision I make, and I work closely with
trusted medical doctors to ensure treatments are selected appropriately.

 

I aim to provide balanced information so patients can make informed decisions about their care.

 

All treatments must require a consultation to assess suitability. For more information, please
contact the clinic.

## Frequently Asked Questions

## Who is a dermatologist doctor?

 A dermatologist is a medical doctor who specializes in the treatment of skin and hair conditions.
They provide care for patients of all ages, from infants to the elderly. In addition to addressing
various skin diseases and issues, dermatologists also offer cosmetic and anti-aging procedures. Dr.
Tanveer Fatima is one such dermatologist who treats conditions like acne, warts, hair loss,
birthmarks, scars, and provides cosmetic and anti-aging treatments.

## What does a dermatologist do?

Dermatologists are responsible for diagnosing and treating a wide range of skin conditions. During
the initial appointment, Dr. Tanveer Fatima, the top skin specialist in Roorkee, will conduct a
thorough evaluation of the patient's skin. This involves discussing the onset of the problem,
symptoms experienced, and any prior treatments attempted. Dermatologists may also perform surgical
procedures or laser surgery when necessary. Additionally, Dr. Tanveer Fatima has expertise in
cosmetic treatments like anti-wrinkle injections, fillers, and chemical peels.

##  

## When should you go to the dermatologist?

 Regular visits to a dermatologist are crucial for maintaining healthy skin. It is recommended to
have a skin examination at least once a year. If someone experiences a rash, abnormal growths, or
persistent acne, it is advisable to consult a dermatologist promptly. Skin screening is one of the
essential reasons to see a dermatologist, as changes in the skin can occur over time, and early
identification of any issues is vital.

##  

## What is the difference between a cosmetologist and a dermatologist?

A dermatologist is a qualified medical doctor specialising in the treatment of skin and hair
problems. They can prescribe medications, perform dermatosurgery, and offer services to the general
public. On the other hand, cosmetology focuses on procedures aimed at enhancing physical
characteristics such as hair, nails, and skin. Services provided by cosmetologists include chemical
peels, laser treatments, wrinkle removal, and medical facial treatments. Dermatology and cosmetology
are distinct fields with different areas of expertise.

##  

## Should I see a dermatologist for my acne?

Acne can be a frustrating condition, affecting a large number of people at some point in their
lives. If acne persists or becomes severe, it is advisable to consult a dermatologist. Dr. Tanveer
Fatima, the top skin specialist in Roorkee, is known for providing quick and effective acne
treatments tailored to individual needs. Leaving acne untreated can lead to scarring, so seeking
treatment promptly is important.

##  

## When should I see a dermatologist for hair loss?

Hair loss is a common occurrence, with individuals typically losing 50 to 100 hairs per day.
However, if hair loss is excessive or noticeable thinning occurs in specific areas, it is
recommended to schedule an appointment with a dermatologist. Dr. Tanveer Fatima, renowned as the
best dermatologist in Roorkee for treating hair loss, will examine the scalp, inquire about the
duration of hair loss, medication history, and family baldness history. Based on the investigation,
she will diagnose the underlying cause of hair loss and suggest appropriate treatment options.

##  

## Does a dermatologist provide online consultation?

Due to the pandemic and the increased workload of dermatologists, online consultations have become
more prevalent. Experienced dermatologists can diagnose skin issues through text, audio, or video
consultations and provide suitable treatment recommendations. Dr. Tanveer Fatima, the best
dermatologist in Roorkee, also offers online consultations to her patients.

##  

## Why is Dr. Tanveer Fatima the Best Dermatologist in Roorkee?

Dr. Tanveer Fatima has earned a reputation as the best dermatologist in Roorkee due to her extensive
experience in treating various skin issues, including critical dermatological diseases. With a track
record of providing effective treatment to numerous patients, she prioritises individualised care
and achieves outstanding results. Her vast knowledge and expertise in the field of dermatology set
her apart from other practitioners.

##  

## Does a Dermatologist carry out Plastic & Cosmetic procedures?

Dermatologists are trained to perform minor surgical procedures known as dermatosurgy. These
procedures may include nail avulsion, wart removal, skin tag removal, and vitiligo surgeries, among
others.

## Frequently Asked Questions

## Who is a dermatologist doctor?

 A dermatologist is a medical doctor who specializes in the treatment of skin and hair conditions.
They provide care for patients of all ages, from infants to the elderly. In addition to addressing
various skin diseases and issues, dermatologists also offer cosmetic and anti-aging procedures. Dr.
Tanveer Fatima is one such dermatologist who treats conditions like acne, warts, hair loss,
birthmarks, scars, and provides cosmetic and anti-aging treatments.

## What does a dermatologist do?

Dermatologists are responsible for diagnosing and treating a wide range of skin conditions. During
the initial appointment, Dr. Tanveer Fatima, the top skin specialist in Roorkee, will conduct a
thorough evaluation of the patient's skin. This involves discussing the onset of the problem,
symptoms experienced, and any prior treatments attempted. Dermatologists may also perform surgical
procedures or laser surgery when necessary. Additionally, Dr. Tanveer Fatima has expertise in
cosmetic treatments like anti-wrinkle injections, fillers, and chemical peels.

##  

## When should you go to the dermatologist?

 Regular visits to a dermatologist are crucial for maintaining healthy skin. It is recommended to
have a skin examination at least once a year. If someone experiences a rash, abnormal growths, or
persistent acne, it is advisable to consult a dermatologist promptly. Skin screening is one of the
essential reasons to see a dermatologist, as changes in the skin can occur over time, and early
identification of any issues is vital.

##  

## What is the difference between a cosmetologist and a dermatologist?

A dermatologist is a qualified medical doctor specialising in the treatment of skin and hair
problems. They can prescribe medications, perform dermatosurgery, and offer services to the general
public. On the other hand, cosmetology focuses on procedures aimed at enhancing physical
characteristics such as hair, nails, and skin. Services provided by cosmetologists include chemical
peels, laser treatments, wrinkle removal, and medical facial treatments. Dermatology and cosmetology
are distinct fields with different areas of expertise.

##  

## Should I see a dermatologist for my acne?

Acne can be a frustrating condition, affecting a large number of people at some point in their
lives. If acne persists or becomes severe, it is advisable to consult a dermatologist. Dr. Tanveer
Fatima, the top skin specialist in Roorkee, is known for providing quick and effective acne
treatments tailored to individual needs. Leaving acne untreated can lead to scarring, so seeking
treatment promptly is important.

##  

## When should I see a dermatologist for hair loss?

Hair loss is a common occurrence, with individuals typically losing 50 to 100 hairs per day.
However, if hair loss is excessive or noticeable thinning occurs in specific areas, it is
recommended to schedule an appointment with a dermatologist. Dr. Tanveer Fatima, renowned as the
best dermatologist in Roorkee for treating hair loss, will examine the scalp, inquire about the
duration of hair loss, medication history, and family baldness history. Based on the investigation,
she will diagnose the underlying cause of hair loss and suggest appropriate treatment options.

##  

## Does a dermatologist provide online consultation?

Due to the pandemic and the increased workload of dermatologists, online consultations have become
more prevalent. Experienced dermatologists can diagnose skin issues through text, audio, or video
consultations and provide suitable treatment recommendations. Dr. Tanveer Fatima, the best
dermatologist in Roorkee, also offers online consultations to her patients.

##  

## Why is Dr. Tanveer Fatima the Best Dermatologist in Roorkee?

Dr. Tanveer Fatima has earned a reputation as the best dermatologist in Roorkee due to her extensive
experience in treating various skin issues, including critical dermatological diseases. With a track
record of providing effective treatment to numerous patients, she prioritises individualised care
and achieves outstanding results. Her vast knowledge and expertise in the field of dermatology set
her apart from other practitioners.

##  

## Does a Dermatologist carry out Plastic & Cosmetic procedures?

Dermatologists are trained to perform minor surgical procedures known as dermatosurgy. These
procedures may include nail avulsion, wart removal, skin tag removal, and vitiligo surgeries, among
others.

# Quality Dermatology in NYC For Patients Of All Skin Types

At Aglow Dermatology, we take pride in offering dermatology services to patients of all skin tones
and textures. Our mission is to provide comprehensive dermatological solutions. We not only address
immediate concerns but also improve your long-term skin health and confidence.

We work closely with each patient to create a personalized treatment plan. Whether you need general
dermatology or a specialist in NYC, our practice is here to meet your needs.

Conveniently located in Midtown Manhattan, Dr. Strachan provides exceptional cosmetic and medical
dermatology.

## Comprehensive Dermatology Services in NYC

Are you searching for an expert dermatology practice in NYC? At Aglow Dermatology, we believe that
everyone deserves high-quality treatment options.

Dr. Dina Strachan, a board-certified dermatologist with Harvard and Yale credentials, leads Aglow.
Our practice specializes in providing personalized treatments for all skin types.

Dr. Strachan is renowned for her expertise in treating acne and managing hair and skin disorders.
She also excels at dermatological care for skin of color.

As a leading dermatologist in Manhattan, NYC, Dr. Strachan combines extensive knowledge with a
compassionate approach. She provides both medical and cosmetic treatments.

Более десяти лет я занимаюсь пластической хирургией, помогая людям менять не только внешность,

## Какие задачи решает врач

Избыток кожи, мешки под глазами, опущение век или ощущение постоянно уставшего взгляда.

### Усталый взгляд и нависшие веки

001 Пластика лица
Изменение положения бровей, нависание тканей и выраженные возрастные изменения верхней трети лица.

### Опущение бровей и тяжёлый взгляд

001 Пластика лица
Изменение пропорций, западение тканей, выраженные носогубные складки или потеря объёма в области
скул, век и губ.

### Недостаток объёма лица

002 Пластика Тела

вскармливания и снижения веса.

### Изменение формы или объёма груди

Избыток кожи, диастаз, локальные жировые отложения и изменение контура живота после беременности или
снижения веса.

### Изменения в области живота

002 Пластика Тела
Желание скорректировать контуры, восполнить объём отдельных зон или сделать пропорции более
гармоничными.

## Hair Transplant Options and Techniques

DHI Hair Transplant Sapphire FUE Hair Transplant Hair Transplant for Women Beard Transplant

### DHI Hair Transplants: Precision and Natural Results

A DHI transplant is the newest and improved version of a FUE hair transplant. The harvesting
procedure stays the same if we compare it to a FUE transplant. However, during implantation,
different Choi-pens are used as they can both open channels and insert the grafts at the same time.

This method also makes the unshaven hair transplant method, long DHI, possible. The recipient site
does not have to be shaved.

A DHI procedure is always best, and it’s mostly suitable if you want a transplant without shaving,
greater density, a more sensitive approach, the latest state of the art technology, and the most
natural results.

### Sapphire FUE Hair Transplant: Advanced Method for Optimal Outcomes

A Sapphire FUE Transplant follows the same procedure as a classic FUE transplant. However, the
operation is performed using blades made of a precious gemstone called sapphire.

The use of a sapphire pen instead of a metal slit allows cuts that are quite small. This allows
faster wound healing.

A Sapphire FUE is more delicate than the classic FUE method but not as delicate as a DHI. Also, a
Sapphire FUE doesn’t allow the same density as a DHI.

### Woman Hair Transplant

A female hair transplant is a the procedure focusing on finding a permanent solution to women
experiencing hair loss or thinning hair. It is no different than any other hair transplant however a
DHI with no shaving is preferred for aesthetic reasons.

Your hair won’t be shaved in the receiving area, while the donor area will receive thin horizontal
shaving you’ll be able to cover with your surrounding hair. All of this is done to ensure an
easy-to-hide operation.

### Beard Transplant

A beard transplant is a permanent solution for a patchy beard and lasts forever if performed
properly. This treatment carried out by extracting hair follicles from the back of the head, between
the two ears, under the chin or from the neck and implanting them to the desired areas on the face.

The preferred method for this transplant is a DHI transplant with Choi Pens. This allow for a more
delicate implantation with no visibile scars on your face.

## A complete range for every need

## Classic Line

Experience **DSD de Luxe**’s high-quality cosmeceutical hair care line, expertly formulated to
restore scalp balance and enhance hair health and density. Each treatment targets key hair and scalp
concerns: including **excess sebum, dandruff, weakness, lack of vitality and density, and hair
loss**, leaving the hair stronger, revitalized, and perfectly balanced.

## Medline

**MEDLINE** by **DSD de Luxe** is an advanced organic line designed for hair loss treatment and
scalp detox. Enriched with growth factors and naturally derived actives, it promotes hair
strengthening, regeneration, and vitality from the root, restoring a healthier scalp environment.

[ Discover ][163]

## Opium Line

The action of these products is focused on **reducing hair loss, revitalizing the hair follicle, and
enhancing hair density and thickness**. Their comprehensive effect improves hair strength, vitality,
and overall quality, resulting in fuller, healthier, and more resilient hair.

[ Discover ][164]

## Skincare

The **SKINCARE** line by **DSD de Luxe** merges advanced science with high-performance
cosmeceuticals to enhance the health and appearance of the skin. Developed with innovative
biotechnological ingredients, it targets **key signs of ageing, dehydration, and loss of firmness**,
leaving the skin brighter, smoother, and revitalized. A scientifically driven and sensorial
experience, true to DSD de Luxe’s commitment to excellence and dermatological innovation.
